title: Open phone piece explanations on tap with close-up zoom
summary: Phone Lab component taps now open the selected piece explanation immediately, with 1x/2x/3x close-up controls and contextual AI teacher actions.

changes.detail: A single tap on a mapped phone component opens its explanation and selected crop instead of requiring a double tap.
Added 1x, 2x and 3x close-up controls inside the selected piece dialog.
Kept Explain, example, quiz and custom question actions connected to the authenticated AI Teacher with trusted lesson context.
